name: delete_calendar_event
description: Delete a single calendar event, or cancel one occurrence of a recurring series. Never deletes a whole recurring series — use delete_repeating_calendar_event for that.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: The Google Calendar event ID to delete. For a single occurrence of a recurring event, use the instance id (e.g. 'abc123_20260411T030000Z').

inputs.name: cascade
inputs.description: If True, also delete linked children (reminders, sub-events) in the local repository.

metadata.planner_description: Delete a single calendar event or cancel one occurrence of a recurring series. For whole-series deletion use delete_repeating_calendar_event.
